QG1.note: AP per band = positives of the band + all negatives; ignore cells (-1) left out

QG2.note: AP per band = positives of the band + all negatives; ignore cells (-1) left out

QG3.note: AP per band = positives of the band + all negatives; ignore cells (-1) left out

QG4.note: probes fitted on complete S1-train data (C of QG1 / QG3); missing_dem = only the WAC available at test time; F-X / F-CM: mask token of the missing modality; F-C: missing half = the S1-train mean (any constant fill gives the same AP with a linear probe, checked with zeros); retention = AP with the modality missing / AP complete; single-modality reference = probes trained on that modality alone (QG1 / QG3)

QG6.note: terciles = crater-density strata of QB3.1 (low ~ mare-like, high ~ highland: a proxy, no mare map); block bootstrap inside each tercile (seed + stratum); scores of QG1 / QG3 (probes fitted on S1-train)
